name: Sekisui House, Ltd.
summary: Sekisui House, Ltd. designs, constructs, and contracts built-to-order detached houses in Japan and internationally. It operates through Detached Houses, Rental Housing and Commercial Buildings, Architectural/Civil Engineering, Rental Housing Management, Remodeling, Development, and Overseas segments.
